summary: Emi attends her first traditional Japanese tea ceremony in a peaceful Kyoto garden tearoom.
author: Emi
storyJapanese: 畳の部屋に座ると、心地よい静けさが漂います。先生は丁寧にお茶を点ててくれます。茶筅を振るサラサラという音が響きます。差し出された抹茶は深く鮮やかな緑色でした。甘い和菓子とお茶の苦味が完璧に調和していました。
storyEnglish: Sitting in the tatami room, a pleasant silence floats around. The teacher carefully prepares the tea. The rustling sound of whisking the tea whisk echoes. The matcha presented was a deep and vibrant green. The sweet wagashi and bitter tea harmonized perfectly.
